dateSplitRadar.note: Signal-date split diagnostic, not a full rolling walk-forward test.

restrictedWalkForwardRadar.note: Restricted walk-forward: each year selects from frozen candidate configs only, not the full grid.

fullGridWalkForwardRadar.note: Full-grid walk-forward: each year reranks the full stage-1 config grid using prior signal history.

multiWindowValidationRadar.note: Multi-window validation: evaluates one frozen config across anchored and fixed rolling holdout windows.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Keep the main implementation inside investigations/uptrend_dip_search.py.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: All strategy families, radar evaluation, walk-forward diagnostics, report writing, and Pine generation are wired from investigations/uptrend_dip_search.py.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Do not modify config.py or run.py.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: Session gate: git diff --name-only -- config.py run.py must stay empty.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Explore buy signals: volatility contraction breakout, relative strength, abnormal volume, and large-drawdown add-on points.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: tech_breakout covers compression / relative strength / volume expansion; bottom_reversal covers deep drawdown, multi-bottom/retest, RSI divergence, crash and capitulation; rsi_divergence is a standalone RSI-divergence baseline; index_shallow_pullback covers orderly index dips.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Explore trend filters with ADX and moving-average slope; keep Ichimoku as backup only.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: trend_breakout uses ADX and EMA55 slope. Ichimoku is intentionally not added to avoid unnecessary complexity before the simpler filters are validated.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Explore sell protection: trailing stop, ATR trailing, and profit drawdown protection.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: simulate_trades() includes fixed stop, profit drawdown trailing, ATR trailing, and sell-signal exits; Stage 2 report keeps this separate from the long-term add-on radar.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Optimize for long-term add-on quality, not high short-term win rate.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: Current default is bottom_reversal / btm_d0.30_b0.20_r0.20_c0.20_v0.10_t45; long-term score weights 12m/24m forward returns and penalizes post-entry drawdown.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Avoid buying green momentum-chase bars for the long-term add-on radar.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: evaluate_long_term_radar() requires close < open for add-on entries, so long-term radar signals occur on bearish candles.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Support deep crashes, double bottoms / multi-bottoms, and RSI divergence.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: bottom_reversal scoring uses drawdown_252, bottom_retest_score, multi-bottom count, RSI divergence, crash score, and capitulation score.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Add index_shallow_pullback with strength labels distinct from bottom_reversal.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: Report and Pine emit Deep Bottom vs Shallow Pullback labels; index_shallow_pullback has its own threshold, weights, and re-signal rule.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Expand validation to the requested tech subset.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: Tech subset summary covers 12 symbols; current watchlist contains 7 recent global-default tech signals.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Run QQQ quick validation, then full --symbol all validation when it does not deteriorate.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: Session gates: python investigations/uptrend_dip_search.py --symbol QQQ and python investigations/uptrend_dip_search.py --symbol all.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Reduce overfitting risk before treating the strategy as usable.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: Date-split holdout starts at 2023-01-01; full-grid walk-forward covers years [2023, 2024, 2025, 2026]; multi-window validation has 4 anchored windows and 4 rolling windows.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Keep TradingView Pine output synchronized and compatible with TradingView's function set.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: run() regenerates uptrend_dip_pine.pine and long_term_addon_radar.pine; Pine uses rolling_count() instead of unsupported rolling-sum function calls.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Do not claim production readiness from in-sample or proxy signals alone.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: Report caveats keep the conservative read separate from per-symbol in-sample best configs and call for live paper-trading or a later true out-of-sample period before production use.

promptToArtifactChecklist.requirement: Track future paper-validation checkpoints for current tech signals.
promptToArtifactChecklist.evidence: paperTrackingPlan tracks 7 signals; next pending check date is 2026-05-19; overdue pending 6m/12m checks are 0 / 0.
